title: ChipOmni: A General-Purpose AI Agent for Electronic Design Automation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electronic design automation (EDA) workflows remain highly fragmented, requiring engineers to coordinate heterogeneous representations, specialised software tools, and iterative verification across multiple design stages. Although large language models have brought more general reasoning and code-generation capabilities to EDA, many existing approaches remain focused on isolated tasks and struggle to plan, verify, and repair designs autonomously within executable engineering environments. Here we introduce ChipOmni, a knowledge-enhanced, context-evolving AI agent framework for EDA. ChipOmni integrates multimodal understanding, dynamic planning, multi-agent collaboration, and verification-driven tool interaction into a unified autonomous system. By continually incorporating feedback from external engineering tools, the framework maintains an evolving task context, integrates domain knowledge, and iteratively refines intermediate designs.

translated_title: ChipOmni：面向电子设计自动化的通用人工智能智能体
translated_abstract: 电子设计自动化（EDA）工作流程仍然高度碎片化，需要工程师协调异构的表示形式、专业化的软件工具以及跨多个设计阶段的迭代验证。尽管大语言模型为EDA带来了更通用的推理和代码生成能力，但许多现有方法仍专注于孤立的任务，难以在可执行的工程环境中自主地规划、验证和修复设计。我们提出了ChipOmni，这是一个面向EDA的知识增强、上下文持续演化的AI智能体框架。ChipOmni将多模态理解、动态规划、多智能体协作以及验证驱动的工具交互集成到一个统一的自主系统中。通过持续吸收来自外部工程工具的反馈，该框架能够维护一个不断演化的任务上下文，融合领域知识，并迭代地优化中间设计。
tldr: ChipOmni是一个面向电子设计自动化的知识增强AI智能体框架，通过融合多模态理解、动态规划、多智能体协作与验证驱动的工具交互，实现了EDA设计中自主规划、验证与修复的统一自动化系统。
en_tdlr: ChipOmni is a knowledge-enhanced, context-evolving AI agent framework for electronic design automation that integrates multimodal understanding, dynamic planning, multi-agent collaboration, and verification-driven tool interaction into a unified autonomous system capable of planning, verifying, and repairing designs.
